title: Rechargeable Battery Drop-Box Pilot for Two Campus Buildings
description: This project will fund two clearly labeled battery collection boxes, terminal tape, and printed safety instructions for a campus pilot focused on used AA, AAA, and button batteries. Too many dead batteries still end up in drawers or general trash because students do not know where to take them. By placing small collection stations in high-traffic study buildings and pairing them with a simple weekly pickup routine, we can make responsible battery recycling feel obvious instead of inconvenient.
